entities.summary: Ludmila Oliveira da Silva, known mononymously as Ludmilla, is a Brazilian singer-songwriter who became known with the song "Fala Mal de Mim". In September 2020, she became the first Afro-Latin American female musician to reach one billion streams on Spotify.
